body.statement: Conditional on the disclosed one-direction condition \texttt{ass:attainable-local-modulus}, there exist constants \(0<c<C<\infty\), depending only on the fixed class parameters, such that for every growth array with \(N\wedge T\wedge\min_s n_s\to\infty\), every interior realized path \(z_0\), and every exact design array with \(g_{sT}(z_0)<1\), \[cR_D\le\inf_{\widetilde\tau}\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}}\mathbb E_P[(\widetilde\tau-\tau(z_0))^2\mid z_0,(X_{st})]\le\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}}\mathbb E_P[(\widehat\tau-\tau(z_0))^2\mid z_0,(X_{st})]\le CR_D.\] The lower bound is witnessed inside the same causal class by separate treated-mean, replicated Holder-bump, empty-neighborhood, and covariance-aligned donor-location subexperiments; specifically, the \(N^{-\kappa}\) converse uses the maintained direction. The upper-bound assertion includes a uniform bound on \(\Pr_P(\mathsf F_{\mathrm{fb}}\mid z_0,(X_{st}))\) strong enough that the squared error of the clipped pooled-mean fallback is absorbed by \(R_D\); the proof must count that event and may not analyze it as regular Gram geometry. The total feasible estimator has no additional tensor-Gram or deconvolution phase.
body.justification: This is the theorem-level kernel: it resolves the four information channels on every relative-growth regime before averaging over random design geometry.
body.gap: Fan (1993) and Fan et al. (1997) treat ordinary pointwise smoothing; Akhavan, Gogolashvili, and Tsybakov (2024) evaluate at an estimated minimizer. None gives a causal replicated-site frontier with an external nonregular donor center, realized holes, arbitrary sample-size ratios, and four same-class converses.
body.consumer: Researchers can read the active bottleneck directly from observed cohort replication, calendar coverage, and donor count, and can avoid unnecessary Fourier deconvolution when only the event query is generated.
